name: TZ Medical Inc
old_description: We improve patient care through innovative medical devices that meet and exceed our customers' expectations.
about:
TZ Medical Inc was founded in 1990 by Tom Tribou in a Portland, Oregon coffee shop. Now headquartered in Tualatin, Oregon, the company began with a two-part philosophy: listen to front-line medical professionals to understand their needs before engineering solutions, and price those solutions at a value level so they reach critical-care providers faster.

The company designs and manufactures a range of single-use and reusable medical devices. Its portfolio includes radial access sheaths such as the Skyline XT™ thin-wall sheath, the Cobra Board radial buttress device, radiation protection systems under the URPro line, cardiac monitoring solutions, the Beata Clasp® medical line organizer, the Pullie™ surgical pannus retractor, anesthesia tube holders, and lead apron racks. Products are sold across the United States and internationally.

TZ Medical serves hospitals, catheterization labs, labor and delivery units, and cardiac monitoring programs. Customers cited in company materials include Abington Jefferson Health, O'Connor Hospital, Providence Newberg Medical Center, The Christ Hospital, and Presence St. Joseph Medical Center in Joliet.

The founding premise remains the company's stated differentiator: ideas originate from clinicians, not internal engineers alone, and pricing is structured to be accessible without tiered purchasing commitments. The company also emphasizes responsive customer service and tailored account support.
